purpose: Quantify the sensitivity/specificity and operational loss tradeoff of already-frozen Gate21 95th vs 98th percentile causal change alarms and fully marginalized Bayesian 95th control; no new worlds, no cutoff tuning, no claim of improved intelligence.
amalgam_owner: Amalgam PR #1278 solely authorized for native integration
cohort: 200 separate NULL calibration worlds and 384 held primary worlds already consumed; 96 NULL, 96 SINGLE_EDGE, 96 DOUBLE_EDGE and 96 NONLINEAR_AND at 20% flip noise; evaluate familiar changes on SINGLE+DOUBLE only, exclude out-of-family from decision-policy pass.

analysis.exact_truth: For each held world NULL=>unchanged, SINGLE/DOUBLE=>changed; NONLINEAR_AND excluded from matched XOR familiar analysis.
analysis.confusion: Compute per-policy TP FN FP TN, overall and separately SINGLE/DOUBLE; no threshold changes.
analysis.paired: Compute paired 2x2 correctness on SAME 192 changed and 96 NULL worlds (candidate95 vs candidate98, candidate95 vs full95) with two-sided exact discordance sign test for familiarity; report count, not imply external reproducibility.
analysis.uncertainty: 95% Wilson two-sided intervals for observed shifted recall and NULL false-alarm rates, including exact zero-alarm caution.
analysis.risk: Expected policy loss L=p_change*(1-TPR)*C_FN+(1-p_change)*FPR*C_FP. Evaluate p_change=[0.01,0.05,0.10,0.25,0.50] and cost ratio C_FP/C_FN=[1,5,10,25]. Only illustrative sensitivity analysis, not calibrated real-world probabilities or action costs. Report crossover for candidate95 vs candidate98: p*=fpr95*ratio/(tpr95-tpr98+fpr95*ratio) with zero fpr98 from held; no use to tune source.
analysis.calibration: Reconstruct pre-frozen candidate and full 95%/98% thresholds from 200 retained NULL calibration score rows before calculating held outcomes (ranks 191/197); if mismatch fail closed.
analysis.cross_source: Verify original row counts, 24 OLD, 16 NEW, first 12 distinct contexts, original 6 model probabilities finite, exact source Git blob and archived verdict SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO.
analysis.presentation: Report all four principal policy rows and risk matrix plus failure/limits, no cherry-picked best scenario.
analysis.negative_controls: The separate audit must reject a modified calibration threshold and flipped primary truth label, without rerunning consumed worlds.

verdict_contract: ANALYSIS_ONLY. Scientific evidence NOT upgraded; native first-use, cold retention and measured intelligence gains remain UNVERIFIED. No new native model checkpoint, owner runner, scheduler, workflow, accepted main or merge. CI still atlas-index blocked.
